name: Aaron Jensen
source:
Study. Study. Study. Aside from the occasional hours of gaming to rest his mind, all Aaron ever does is study, whether he be memorizing obscure algorithms or preparing for a test. Certainly nobody was surprised when he selected computer science as his major. He attended the same high school as Valerie, and while she only ever talked to him once or twice, even she knows what a geek he is. He has a penchant for falling in love, although he struggles to act on his feelings, which...is probably not a good thing. Does a soulmate exist, even for him?

[From [url=https://ebullience-games.itch.io/red-string-of-fate]itch.io[/url]]
